speech_text:
Air Quality Alert issued November 22 at 12:46PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK.

The Department of Environmental Conservation has issued an Air Quality Alert which is IN EFFECT UNTIL 2 PM AKST MONDAY. North Pole has a Stage 2 alert. Fairbanks has no alert.
